objective: To generate continuous and sustainable employment opportunities in rural and urban areas through setting up of new micro-enterprises, small manufacturing units, and service ventures.
benefits: Margin money subsidy ranging from 15% to 35% of project cost with bank-financed term loans up to 50 lakhs for manufacturing and 20 lakhs for service sector.
target_beneficiary: Individual entrepreneurs, artisans, rural and urban unemployed youth, SC/ST, women, and physically disabled individuals starting new ventures.

objective: To provide collateral-free institutional micro-credit to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises for income-generating activities and working capital.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to 10 lakhs categorized under Shishu (up to 50k), Kishore (50k to 5L), and Tarun (5L to 10L) with affordable interest rates.
target_beneficiary: Small retail shopkeepers, tailors, food delivery operators, repair shops, artisans, transport operators, and self-employed micro-entrepreneurs.

objective: To provide end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople producing goods with their hands and tools, enhancing quality and market reach.
benefits: Skill upgrading training with stipend, toolkit incentive of 15,000 rupees, collateral-free enterprise development credit up to 3 lakhs at concessional 5% interest rate, and digital transaction incentives.
target_beneficiary: Traditional artisans, craftspeople, tailors (Darzi), carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, cobblers, weavers, and sculptors from rural and urban informal sectors.

objective: To facilitate bank loans to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and Women entrepreneurs in greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Composite bank loans between 10 lakhs and 1 crore for setting up greenfield ventures in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sectors.
target_beneficiary: Women entrepreneurs, SC and ST micro-enterprises establishing their first commercial venture.

scheme_name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
objective: To organize traditional artisans and rural craftspersons into sustainable clusters to make them competitive, market-driven, and economically viable.
benefits: Grant assistance up to 2.5 crores for regular clusters and 5 crores for major clusters for common facility centers, modern machinery, design inputs, and market support.
target_beneficiary: Artisans, traditional craft clusters, khadi institutions, self-help groups (SHGs), and rural producer collectives.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
objective: To assist educated first-generation youth in Tamil Nadu in establishing new manufacturing or service enterprises through financial assistance and entrepreneurship training.
benefits: 25% capital subsidy on project cost up to 75 lakhs with 3% interest subvention and EDP training facilitation through state agencies.
target_beneficiary: First-generation educated youth, graduates, diploma holders, women, SC/ST, and transgender entrepreneurs residing in Tamil Nadu.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
objective: To facilitate collateral-free credit flow from commercial banks to micro and small manufacturing and service enterprises.
benefits: Credit guarantee cover up to 85% for credit facilities up to 5 crores without requiring third-party guarantees or collateral security.
target_beneficiary: Micro and small manufacturing, service, educational institutions, retail trade, and self-employed professionals needing scale-up capital.

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
objective: To provide financial, technical and business support for the upgradation of existing micro food processing enterprises and farmer producer organizations.
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of the eligible project cost up to a maximum of 10 lakhs per unit, plus marketing and branding support.
target_beneficiary: Micro food processing units, self-help groups, farmer producer organizations, and food entrepreneurs seeking quality upgrades.

objective: To mobilize medium to long term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: Interest subvention of 3% per annum up to a limit of 2 crores for a maximum period of 7 years, alongside credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
target_beneficiary: Agri-entrepreneurs, primary agricultural credit societies, start-ups, and farmer groups building storage, sorting, and grading facilities.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
objective: To mitigate unemployment issues among youth in Tamil Nadu by helping them establish micro manufacturing, service, and business enterprises.
benefits: 25% subsidy on project cost up to 15 lakhs for manufacturing, 5 lakhs for service, and 5 lakhs for business enterprises, with collateral-free bank loans.
target_beneficiary: Unemployed youth belonging to economically backward classes, rural communities, and urban youth in Tamil Nadu.
